title: WebXR
description: Publish WebXR apps for local testing or on the web.

settings.label: Localhost
settings.hint: Test on this computer over loopback HTTPS.

config.label: HTTPS origin
config.hint: The site address, for example https://apps.example.

config.label: Output repository
config.hint: owner/name of the repository the site is served from.

config.label: Output branch
config.hint: The branch the hosting serves. Publishing uses your Git sign-in; no credentials are stored here.

config.label: Initial branch
config.hint: Optional: creates a missing output branch from this one. Empty uses the output branch.

config.label: Site subtree
config.hint: / or the one repository folder the hosting serves.

config.label: Verification timeout (ms)
config.hint: How long to wait for a published app to become reachable.
